subject: [RFC PATCH 1/5] mm: let folio_mkclean() report which pages had dirty PTEs

2026-09-03.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new function, folio_mkclean_dirtymap(), which reports the pages of a folio that had dirty PTEs during the clearing process. The existing folio_mkclean() function is modified to use this new function and pass no bitmap, maintaining its original behavior. This change allows for more accurate tracking of page modifications in large folios, where only the per-entry dirty bit was previously recorded.
